technical_notes.bfcl_loader_fix: Successfully implemented subset support for BFCL dataset. The gorilla-llm/Berkeley-Function-Calling-Leaderboard dataset has multiple JSON files (BFCL_v3_simple.json, BFCL_v3_multiple.json, etc.) that require specific file loading via data_files parameter rather than standard split loading.
technical_notes.model_limitations: gemma4:e4b has a 32-token output limit which prevents completion of HellaSwag tasks requiring multiple-choice selection from long contexts. This is a model architecture limitation, not a framework bug.
technical_notes.checkpoint_system: All tasks support checkpoint/resume functionality. Checkpoints saved in .checkpoints/ directory with atomic writes.
